fact_notes: Keith Farrelle Cozart, born Aug 15, 1995, Chicago; raised by grandmother Margaret Carter; lived at Parkway Garden Homes, Washington Park, South Side (Wikipedia).
Dec 2011: arrested (gun charge), placed under house arrest at his grandmother's residence; aged 16. Posted videos to YouTube while confined (Wikipedia).
'I Don't Like' (feat. Lil Reese, prod. Young Chop) video by DGainz, released March 2012, filmed at his grandmother's house during house arrest.
Kanye West remixed it ('Don't Like.1' with Pusha T, Jadakiss, Big Sean) for GOOD Music's Cruel Summer, 2012.
Interscope deal 2012: reported $6,000,000 over three albums plus $440,000 for GBE imprint (Wikipedia, citing press).
'Love Sosa' (prod. Young Chop) released 2012; on Finally Rich (Dec 18, 2012).
Drill: the term predates Keef (credited to Pac Man / King Louie), but Keef's 2012 breakout made it known nationally; hence 'the world learns its name' rather than 'the sound gets a name'.
UK drill emerged in Brixton, London ~2012-2014; Brooklyn drill rose ~2019 (Pop Smoke, Sheff G).
